name: Chinese room
observable: Room outline and two distinct slot mechanisms
Input cards become rule-matched output cards
Camera enters slot with parallax
reject: Only a generic tunnel or Chinese architecture

name: Shoggoth
observable: Friendly front face with definite eyes and mouth
Face halves separate in opposite directions
Tendrils or eye organs occupy the exposed back
reject: Mask remains intact throughout or is hidden by line noise

name: Sharp left turn
observable: Constraint cage and moving capability initially coincide
Moving structure takes a new direction
Constraint cage is visibly left behind
reject: Camera turns but relationship of objects never changes

name: Paperclip
observable: Recognizable source objects and target paperclip
Source objects shrink or stretch toward mechanism
New clips multiply from the converted material
reject: Pre-existing clips only spin in place

name: Orthogonality
observable: Two perpendicular independent axes with right-angle bracket
Ability complexity or height increases
Goal stays fixed on same small paperclip
reject: Both axes scale together or target changes with ability

name: Post Chinchilla
observable: Sparse large model lattice
Multiple denser data streams enter a tightened lattice
New lattice crosses separate safety fences
reject: Just a rodent outline or generic fence explosion

name: Recursive upgrade
observable: One maker structure fabricates an improved nested maker
Child begins producing a next generation before handoff
Camera moves through multiple generations
reject: Same concentric ring zoom with no maker-child action
